req.title: Basic-auth rejects missing header
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 401 when the Authorization header is entirely absent from a request to /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must return HTTP 401 when the Authorization header is entirely absent. We need: (1) a negative test confirming 401 with no Authorization header, (2) a positive test confirming 200 with correct credentials, and (3) a boundary test confirming 401 when Authorization header is present but malformed/wrong. We also test the WWW-Authenticate response header on 401 to catch mutations in the status_code helper, and assert exact JSON payload on 200 to catch boolean/string mutations. The check_basic_auth function returns falsy when request.authorization is None (absent header), so we must verify both the None path and the truthy path.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_missing_header_returns_401
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No Authorization header is sent with the request
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/user/passwd with no Authorization header
Assert WWW-Authenticate header is present (set by status_code(401) helper)
expected: WWW-Authenticate header present with Basic realm
trace: R-HTTPBIN-020: absent Authorization header must yield 401
check_basic_auth returns falsy when request.authorization is None
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_missing_header_returns_401():
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/user/passwd')
    assert r.status_code == 401
    assert 'WWW-Authenticate' in r.headers
    assert 'Basic' in r.headers['WWW-Authenticate']
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 403

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Authorization header is present with correct Base64-encoded credentials
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/myuser/mypasswd with correct Basic auth header
Assert JSON body contains authenticated=True and user='myuser'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-020: correct credentials must yield 200 with payload
check_basic_auth returns True when credentials match
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200():
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'myuser:mypasswd').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/myuser/mypasswd',
        headers={'Authorization': 'Basic ' + creds}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'myuser'
    assert data.get('authenticated') is not False
    assert len(data) == 2

tests.name: test_basic_auth_missing_header_no_json_authenticated_field
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/admin/secret with no Authorization header
Assert response body does NOT contain authenticated=True
expected: Response body does not contain authenticated=True JSON field
trace: R-HTTPBIN-020: absent header must not return success payload
Boundary: verifies the 401 path does not accidentally return 200 payload
Catches mutation where check_basic_auth condition is negated
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_missing_header_no_json_authenticated_field():
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/admin/secret')
    assert r.status_code == 401
    body = r.data
    assert b'"authenticated": true' not in body
    assert b'authenticated' not in body or b'true' not in body
    www_auth = r.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate', '')
    assert 'Fake Realm' in www_auth
